title: Ten Years On
style_prompt: one repeating four-chord loop Bm - G - D - A, one chord per bar, the same four chords in the same order through the entire song and never anything else, bittersweet acoustic pop love song, 90 BPM, D major, fingerpicked nylon-string guitar up front with a slight Spanish feel, a second acoustic guitar strumming softly on the choruses, short Spanish-style guitar fills between vocal lines, cajon, soft handclaps, upright bass, warm emotional male tenor, close and breathy in the verses, aching and open in the chorus, gentle falsetto lifts, strong unforgettable vocal melody that lingers sweetly on the major third, big singable chorus hook, warm natural room sound, raw heartfelt performance, nostalgic and tender, quiet opening that builds to a full-hearted chorus
negative_style: chord substitutions, flamenco harmony, jazz chords, key change, harsh synths, distorted guitars, aggressive drums, autotune artifacts, lo-fi, rap verse, EDM drop

sections.name: Intro
sections.style_notes: solo nylon guitar, slow and tender, lots of space

sections.name: Verse 1
lines: Five a.m., the sea at Hua Hin like glass
We'd swim out before the town woke up
Fruit from the market in a plastic bag
We'd eat it on the motorbike, and that was enough
sections.style_notes: voice and one guitar only, intimate, no percussion

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, we could burn the whole night down
Then water, the calmest sea around

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the roads, and the beaches we found
Sitting side by side while the sun went down
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: open strumming, handclaps, upright bass, harmonies join, full-hearted

sections.name: Verse 2
lines: Forty kilometres on the motorbike
Any makeshift room would do for the night
We had next to nothing, and we had it all
Another empty beach, watching the sun fall
sections.style_notes: light rolling groove, like the open road, guitar fills answer the vocal

sections.name: Verse 3
lines: We could do it cheap, we could do it grand
You were just as happy with a street-food stand
A few drinks deep, then home, and you'd put Faded on
We'd be asleep before the end of the song
sections.style_notes: same light groove, playful and warm

sections.name: Pre-Chorus
lines: We were fire and fire, I can still feel the heat
Then water, that's the part I keep

sections.name: Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the roads, and the beaches we found
Sitting side by side while the sun went down
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too

sections.name: Verse 4
lines: We built a house, it's yours now, and that's right
I left, and it's the hardest thing I've done in my life
I've been married since, and I'll tell you something true
I don't think of her the way I think of you
sections.style_notes: drops to one guitar and one voice, confessional, almost spoken

sections.name: Bridge
lines: I'm in Australia now, I built a life, I'm fine
I'm not asking for you back, I'm not rewriting time
But if this ever finds you, wherever you are
You'll know it's you, you were the best of it, by far
sections.style_notes: the quietest and most honest moment, fingerpicked, slowly rebuilding

sections.name: Final Chorus
lines: Ten years on, another life, another shore
I don't think about the fights anymore
I think about the roads, and the beaches we found
Sitting side by side while the sun went down
And every year they light the candles, and I think of you
'Cause it's your birthday too
'Cause it's your birthday too
It's your birthday too
sections.style_notes: biggest moment, full band, passionate ad-libs, guitar soaring

sections.name: Outro
lines: Happy birthday to you
And me
sections.style_notes: solo guitar again, almost whispered, slow fade
